venue: Jimmy Kimmel's Comedy Club at The LINQ Promenade

zones.label: GA Seated Preferred
zones.description: GA Seated Preferred is the broad orange center section. It's our pick because it keeps you in the main central viewing area between the closest reserved section and the outer Standard section.

zones.label: GA Seated Standard
zones.description: GA Seated Standard is the purple outer-right section. It gives you a wider angle on the stage from farther out in the room.

zones.label: Reserved 1
zones.description: Reserved 1 is the pink section wrapping closest around the stage. Choose it when being nearest the stage matters most.

zones.label: Premium Booths
zones.description: Premium Booths 1–4 are the four cyan booth areas along the upper-left edge of the chart.

zones.label: RSVD 3
zones.description: RSVD 3 is the upper of the two small reserved blocks beside the Premium Booths.

zones.label: RSVD 2
zones.description: RSVD 2 is the lower of the two small reserved blocks beside the Premium Booths.
